Notes

Works fully offline. The map, GPS tracking, instruments, and the airport list all work with no connection at all, even the first time you open the app.

Airplane mode: most phones disable GPS too unless you separately re-enable Location Services. Turn on location before switching to airplane mode, then check you still get a fix once you're GPS-only.

Phone GPS altitude and heading are less precise than aircraft instruments — treat readings as approximate.
